auxiliary_controller_contracts.reference_behavior: Dwarf auxiliary controllers are selected for XL-family master firmware, built as BOARD=DWARF firmware, bootstrapped from master resources, and refreshed through the puppy task.
non_local_evidence: Dwarf physical boot and RS485 behavior require hardware-smoke proof
Dwarf live toolhead behavior requires simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required proof
auxiliary_controller_contracts.retained_runtime_boundary: Dwarf firmware entrypoint, master-side Dwarf abstraction, Modbus refresh, FIFO, fan, loadcell, accelerometer, and toolhead state remain retained source-backed contracts until Rust auxiliary runtime parity is proven.

auxiliary_controller_contracts.reference_behavior: ModularBed auxiliary firmware is selected for XL/iX-family master boards, built as BOARD=MODULARBED firmware, and refreshed through ModularBed register blocks for bedlet temperatures, ready state, current, and fault state.
non_local_evidence: Remote bedlet heating and overcurrent behavior require hardware-smoke proof
Physical thermal and power-panic interaction requires manual-hardware-required proof
auxiliary_controller_contracts.retained_runtime_boundary: ModularBed firmware entrypoint, master-side ModularBed class, bedlet register refresh, current/fault handling, and safe-state hooks remain retained source-backed contracts.

auxiliary_controller_contracts.reference_behavior: xBuddy Extension auxiliary firmware is selected for COREONE master firmware and exposes retained MMU bridge request/response behavior through the puppy Modbus bus.
non_local_evidence: xBuddy Extension physical startup and MMU bridge behavior require hardware-smoke proof
COREONE live bridge timing requires simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required proof
auxiliary_controller_contracts.retained_runtime_boundary: xBuddy Extension firmware entrypoint, shared MMU bridge protocol, master-side XBuddyExtension class, and Modbus bridge states remain retained source-backed contracts.

auxiliary_controller_contracts.reference_behavior: Dwarf runtime refresh pulls FIFO records, tracks selected toolhead state, exposes loadcell and accelerometer controls, and maps fan, heater, filament sensor, and fault data to master-side consumers.
non_local_evidence: FIFO timing, loadcell activity, accelerometer sampling, and physical toolhead state require hardware-smoke proof
auxiliary_controller_contracts.retained_runtime_boundary: The master puppy task owns live Dwarf refresh and FIFO dispatch; Rust contracts may model states locally but cannot claim physical Dwarf timing proof.

auxiliary_controller_contracts.reference_behavior: ModularBed runtime refresh reads general status, ready bits, currents, bedlet data, fault state, MCU temperature, and writes print-fan, test-heating, reset-overcurrent, and bedlet target commands.
non_local_evidence: Bedlet heating, current fault recovery, and physical safe-state behavior require manual-hardware-required proof
auxiliary_controller_contracts.retained_runtime_boundary: ModularBed register semantics and physical bedlet fault behavior remain retained until hardware-aware parity proof exists.

auxiliary_controller_contracts.reference_behavior: xBuddy Extension is a special STM32H503 retained runtime surface with fpv5-sp-d16 hard-float evidence, dedicated startup assembly, linker scripts, HAL clock setup, and FreeRTOS configuration; it is not collapsed into a generic STM32H5 row.
non_local_evidence: STM32H503 startup, linker, clock, FPU, and FreeRTOS timing require simulator-flow or hardware-smoke proof
auxiliary_controller_contracts.retained_runtime_boundary: The H503-specific startup/linker/clock/FreeRTOS surface stays explicit and separate from generic STM32H5 abstractions.

auxiliary_controller_contracts.reference_behavior: Auxiliary runtime parity must model bootloader, unavailable, active, stopped, updating, update-failed, communication-fault, and unknown-reference-deferred states instead of relying on unconditional availability stubs.
non_local_evidence: Live transition timing and communication-fault recovery require simulator-flow or hardware-smoke proof
auxiliary_controller_contracts.retained_runtime_boundary: The manifest establishes explicit state vocabulary for later Rust contracts while preserving source-backed runtime behavior until non-local proof exists.
